g.text: requested completions; w = wave index
A wave asks the language model for n proposed lines.
w = 0 is the initial request.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: additional wave count
Maximum extra requests after the first when there
are too few valid lines. A rescue wave can be smaller.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: candidate count
Desired number of valid lines before stopping search.
This is a target, not a guarantee or final score check.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: 1 = pass; 0 = fail
Does candidate c satisfy the required checks, such as
syllable count and the applicable repetition rules?

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: internal score units
A rule-based measure used to rank valid lines,
including fit to the flow. It is not a listening score.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: same units as the ranking score
Minimum score a valid line must also meet before
it is eligible for selection.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: distinct candidates after waves 0..w
The proposed lines that were parsed and evaluated,
with duplicates removed. Not necessarily n in total.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: the settings above, kept together
The candidate counts, retry limit, stopping target,
validity tests, scoring rule and threshold.

font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.96px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

g.text: Number of distinct evaluated candidates
that pass V, whether or not selectable.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

g.text: Number passing V and the score threshold.
At least one is needed to choose a line.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.96px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.96px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #168574

g.text: Highest score among selectable lines.
Undefined when there are none.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #168574

g.text: WHY ONE GROUP?
A candidate budget only has meaning together with the rules for accepting and ranking its results.
The counts and best score are outcomes, not knobs; more samples are not independent guarantees.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #168574
